text:
ChargebackBot: NOTICE: Customer dispute opened via processor for charge charge_00555 (card ending 4242). Reason: duplicate_charge. Amount: $1,200.00. Invoice: INV-2026-221. Customer: BetaMetrics (acct: beta-321). Dispute ID: dsp_3344.

Nina: Received email from customer claiming they were billed twice for the same month. They attached two receipts and want a refund. @Sam can you pull the original payment receipt, processor settlement ID, and the invoice PDF?

Sam: Pulling now. Quick snippet: 
``
payment_id: charge_00555
amount: 1200.00
currency: USD
method: card
card_mask: **** **** **** 4242
processor: FastGate
settlement_id: stl_7788
created_at: 1812411200
``
I see two payments on consecutive days: charge_00555 (2026-05-02) and charge_00556 (2026-05-03). Need to confirm if 00556 maps to the same invoice or was an auto-renew retry.

Priya: Check subscription and webhook logs. If the retry created a second invoice, we can refund one and close. If we billed twice for the same invoice, we need to submit evidence to FastGate.

Nina: Customer claims invoice INV-2026-221 appears on both receipts. I have their support transcript showing they received only one seat activation. Uploading transcript to ticket dsp_3344.

Sam: Webhook log shows two invoice.payment_succeeded events: evt_901 and evt_902. evt_901 -> payment charge_00555 -> invoice INV-2026-221. evt_902 -> payment charge_00556 -> invoice INV-2026-222 (different invoice id). Looks like second invoice was generated due to failed webhook retry that re-issued billing.

Priya: Ok that suggests system generated two invoices. Evidence to compile: (1) invoice PDFs for both INV-2026-221 and INV-2026-222, (2) webhook event dump, (3) provisioning logs showing only one seat assigned, (4) support email confirming only one charge intended, (5) merchant descriptor and settlement details.

Nina: I uploaded invoices and provisioning logs to dsp_3344: https://redwood.internal/finance/disputes/dsp_3344/evidence.zip
Also noted billing email to customer on 2026-05-02 with subject "Payment received - INV-2026-221" and on 2026-05-03 "Payment received - INV-2026-222" (system-generated).

StripeOps: FastGate requires a timeline and proof of duplicate billing. Include original invoice PDFs, merchant dashboard screenshot showing two settlements, cardholder communication (support transcript), and a statement that product delivery corresponds to only one invoice. They accept evidence up to 21 days after dispute open.

Priya: I'll draft the rebuttal pack. Recommend offering a refund of the duplicate payment to keep CS happy while we fight the dispute. Nina, confirm if accounting should issue a manual refund (refund_332) pending processor outcome.

Nina: Yes, please prepare a manual refund pending FastGate decision. Marking this thread P2. I will CC the AM to inform the customer.

Sam: Flagging an operational bug: webhook retry logic can re-create invoices if idempotency key missing. I'll open an eng issue and add the link to the dispute ticket.

Nina: Thanks team. Will update dsp_3344 once refund is processed and when the rebuttal is submitted. :white_check_mark:
